visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top hero with the H1, intro and CTAs beside a large contained, rounded image
visualCharacteristics.layout: Text column (~37%) with H1, 24px intro paragraph and a primary + tonal button beside a 16:9 image with a 12px radius (~63%); image on top on mobile.

contentPattern.description: H1, intro paragraph, 2 CTAs, large rounded image right.
contentPattern.structure: Row 1: image. Row 2: text cell (optional eyebrow paragraph, H1, intro paragraph, CTA links: bold = primary, italic = secondary). A single row with an image cell and a text cell also works.
contentPattern.notes: Author the source subtitle as a paragraph, not a heading. The image is the LCP image and is loaded eagerly. Option side-image: same rows; the H1 spans the full width on top and the image sits left of the text (intro 30/36) from 900px, image 4:3 (JLL offering pages, heroStyle "sideImage"). Option bleed (with side-image, JLL landing pages, heroStyle "creative2"): optional eyebrow paragraph above a 60px light H1; the 4:3 image runs to the page edge (top inner corner rounded) beside the lead paragraph (30/36) and further paragraphs (24/32). Option stacked (JLL design-services pages, heroStyle "designServices"): large display eyebrow, full-width 4:3 image, then the 60px light H1 and the intro (30/36) with the CTA on the right from 900px.

usage.description: Page-top hero with the H1 and CTAs beside a contained rounded image.

reuseGuidance: Use for service/hub page heros with a contained image beside the text. Use hero for full-width photo-background heros and hero-banner for clickable promo tiles.
